blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Open-vocabulary 3D occupancy prediction represents scene geometry and semantics in a unified voxel grid, enabling recognition beyond predefined categories. One approach reconstructs scenes with 3D Gaussians and converts them into voxel occupancy. However, Gaussian scale inflation and excessive overlap can distort voxel occupancy predictions, while semantic mixing can arise within Gaussians spanning multiple categories and during 3D--2D semantic feature alignment. We propose GCSR-OCC, which combines geometry calibration and multi-mode query-conditioned semantic routing for indoor occupancy prediction from a single RGB image. The Evidence-Conserving Gaussian-to-Occupancy operator (EC-G2O) uses kernel mass normalization, $p$-norm aggregation, and a learnable gain to suppress scale inflation and excessive local evidence accumulation while calibrating occupancy responses. Multi-mode Query-First Gaussian Semantic Routing (MM-QGSR) matches multiple semantic modes per Gaussian to text queries and aggregates query-specific evidence into voxels through a learnable text-conditioned router. Fine-grained subclass queries and smoothed semantic aggregation further refine voxel-level predictions. Without 3D semantic annotations, GCSR-OCC achieves state-of-the-art performance in open-vocabulary occupancy prediction on Occ-ScanNet, with 63.31% geometric IoU and 27.44% semantic mIoU. It also reduces geometric aggregation latency from 19.76 ms to 12.88 ms. Our code will be made publicly available.
blocks.zh: Open-vocabulary 3D占用预测代表了场景几何学和语义学在一个统一的voxel网格中,能够超越预先定义的类别进行识别. 一种方法是用3D高斯人重建场景,并把它们转换为活塞占用. 然而,高斯规模膨胀和过度重叠会扭曲voxel占用预测,而语义混合则可能在跨越多类的高斯内部和3D-2D语义特征对接期间出现. 我们提出GCSR-OCC,它结合了几何校正和多模态的查询条件语义路由,用于从单一的RGB图像进行室内占用预测. 证据保护高斯人对占领操作员(EC-G2O)使用内核质量正常化,美元-规范聚合,以及可学习的收益来抑制规模通货膨胀和过度的当地证据积累,同时校正入住反应. 多模式查询-First Gaussian语义查询(MM-QGSR)通过可学习的文本条件路由器,将多语义模式在每高斯语中匹配为文本查询并汇总出特定查询证据为voxel. 精细的子类查询和平滑的语义集合可以进一步精炼出活塞级的预测. 没有3D语义说明,GCSR-OCC在Occ-ScanNet的开通地道占用预测中实现了最先进的性能,有63.31%的几何IoU和27.44%的语义mIoU. 它还会将几何集合的延迟从19.76ms降低到12.88ms. 我们的代码会公开

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Semantic 3D occupancy represents scene geometry and semantics in a unified voxel grid [ 30 , 33 , 39 ] , supporting robot navigation and interaction with the environment [ 8 , 10 ] . Real-world categories are diverse and difficult to enumerate, motivating semantic recognition beyond a predefined set of semantic categories [ 6 , 31 ] . This paper addresses monocular open-vocabulary 3D occupancy prediction in indoor scenes, aiming to predict voxel occupancy states and open-vocabulary semantics from a single RGB image.
blocks.zh: 语义3D占用代表了场景几何和语义在统一的voxel网格中[30,33,39],支持机器人导航和与环境的互动[8,10]. 现实世界的类别多种多样,难以列举,激励语义识别超越了预先定义的一套语义类别[6,31]. 本文涉及室内场景中单体开放-vocabulary 3D占用预测,旨在从单一RGB图像中预测voxel占用状态和开放-vocabulary语义.

blocks.en: Direct 3D occupancy prediction from a single RGB image faces challenges from depth ambiguity and occlusion of scene regions by foreground objects, while dense voxel representations entail a trade-off between spatial resolution and computational cost [ 32 , 29 ] . An alternative is to first reconstruct the scene in 3D and then convert the reconstruction into voxel occupancy, a paradigm we term Reconstruction-then-Occupancy (RTO).
blocks.zh: 单张RGB图像的直接3D占用预测面临来自深度模糊和场景区域被前缘物体遮蔽的挑战,而密集的voxel表示则需要空间分辨率和计算成本之间的权衡[32,29]. 另一种方法是首先在3D重建场景,然后将重建转化为voxel占用,我们称之为重建-当时-占领(RTO)的范式.

blocks.en: RTO uses reconstructed 3D structure to guide occupancy prediction. It can leverage geometric priors from pretrained visual geometry models [ 44 , 38 , 36 , 3 ] and incorporate auxiliary supervision on the reconstructed scene to improve geometric consistency [ 14 , 11 , 50 , 46 ] . However, 3D occupancy prediction accuracy depends not only on reconstruction quality but also on the reconstruction-to-occupancy conversion mechanism, which is the focus of this work.
blocks.zh: RTO使用重建的三维结构来指导占用预测. 它可以利用预先训练的视觉几何模型[44,38,36,3]的几何前缀,并纳入重建场景的辅助监督,以提高几何一致性[14,11,50,46]. 然而,3D占用率预测准确性不仅取决于重建质量,还取决于重建到使用转换机制,这是这项工作的重点.

blocks.en: Direct alignment between 3D representations and text remains challenging due to the scarcity of large-scale 3D–text datasets [ 43 , 27 ] . Therefore, several existing methods use pretrained 2D vision–language models [ 28 , 5 ] for semantic supervision. These methods transfer language-aligned features to 3D through image-space correspondences [ 15 ] or rendering supervision [ 18 ] , without requiring 3D semantic annotations [ 1 , 34 , 50 ] . However, 3D-to-2D mapping can associate multiple 3D locations with the same image pixel [ 41 ] . Aggregating their features can mix distinct semantics and degrade voxel-level semantic predictions.
blocks.zh: 由于缺少大型的3D-文本数据集[43,27],三维表述和文本之间的直接一致仍然具有挑战性. 因此,现有几种方法使用预先训练的2D视觉-语言模型[28,5]进行语义监督. 这些方法通过图像空间通信[15]或渲染监理[18]将语言对齐的特征转移到3D,而不需要3D语义注释[1,34,50]. 然而,3D对2D映射可以将多个3D位置与相同的图像像素联系起来[41]. 综合它们的特征可以混合不同的语义学,并降解阴性水平的语义学预测.

blocks.en: LegoOcc [ 50 ] is a representative reconstruction-based approach to monocular open-vocabulary 3D occupancy prediction in indoor scenes. Its opacity-aware, Poisson-based Gaussian-to-occupancy operator stabilizes volumetric aggregation under weak supervision. However, this formulation allows the model to increase occupancy responses through Gaussian scale inflation and greater overlap, without necessarily improving 3D geometric accuracy. On the semantic side, it aggregates Gaussian features before text matching, potentially merging different semantics into a single voxel feature. Although temperature scheduling reduces feature blending during training, text queries still operate on this aggregated representation.
blocks.zh: LegoOcc [50] 是一种具有代表性的基于重建的方法,用于在室内场景中进行单视开放的3D占用预测. 它的不透明意识,基于波森的高斯人对使用操作器在薄弱的监督下稳定了体积聚合. 然而,这种配制使得模型能够通过高斯规模的通货膨胀和更大的重叠来增加占用响应,而不一定提高3D几何精度. 在语义方面,它在文本匹配前将高斯语特征汇总起来,有可能将不同的语义合并成一个单声道特征. 虽然温度表减少了训练期间的特性混合,但文字查询仍然在这个汇总的表述上进行。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 3D Semantic Occupancy Prediction
blocks.zh: 2.1 3D 语义占用预测

blocks.en: Vision-based occupancy prediction lifts image information into 3D to recover scene geometry and semantics [ 40 , 48 ] . MonoScene [ 2 ] combines the Features Line of Sight Projection (FLoSP) module with a 3D context prior for monocular scene completion. VoxFormer [ 20 ] initializes sparse voxel queries from estimated depth and propagates their information to dense voxels through attention. TPVFormer [ 13 ] uses three orthogonal planes to lift and aggregate image features in 3D, enabling dense semantic occupancy prediction under sparse supervision. For indoor scenes, ISO [ 45 ] combines a pretrained depth model with dual feature projection and introduces Occ-ScanNet. EmbodiedOcc [ 42 ] maintains a Gaussian scene memory across successive observations for online occupancy prediction. This paper follows a reconstruction-then-occupancy framework and focuses on converting reconstructed 3D representations into voxel occupancy.
blocks.zh: 基于视觉的占用预测将图像信息提升到3D中以恢复场景几何和语义[40,48]. MonoScene [2] 将视觉投影(FLOSP)的地物线模块与3D上下文结合,在单视场景完成前进行. VoxFormer [20] 从估计的深度初始化稀疏的Voxel查询,并通过注意向稠密的Voxel传播其信息. TPVFormer [13]使用三架正交平面在3D中升降和集成图像特征,使得在分散的监督下能够进行密集的语义占用预测. 对于室内场景,ISO[45]结合了预先训练的深度模型和双重特征投影,并引入Occ-scanNet. EmbodyOcc [42] 在连续的观察中保持高斯的场景内存,用于在线占用预测. 本文遵循了重建时使用的框架,并侧重于将重建的3D表达式转换为voxel占用.

blocks.en: 2.2 Reconstruction-Based Occupancy Prediction
blocks.zh: 2.2 基于重建的占领预测

blocks.en: Reconstruction-based methods model scene geometry using implicit fields [ 21 , 24 , 22 , 23 , 37 ] or explicit 3D primitives [ 25 , 17 , 7 , 9 ] , providing spatial constraints for occupancy prediction. SelfOcc [ 12 ] represents scenes as signed distance fields and learns 3D occupancy through cross-frame image reconstruction. GaussianOcc [ 4 ] learns metric-scale 3D occupancy through Gaussian splatting, using cross-camera constraints and efficient voxel rendering.
blocks.zh: 基于重建的方法模型场景几何,采用隐含字段[21,24,22,23,37]或明显的3D原始字[25,17,7,9],为占用预测提供了空间限制. SelfOcc [12] 代表场景为签名的距离场,通过跨帧图像重建学习3D占用. GaussianOcc [4]通过高斯电镀,使用跨相机约束和高效的voxel渲染,学习度量级3D占用.

blocks.en: Another line of work directly aggregates Gaussian primitives into voxel occupancy. GaussianFormer [ 14 ] reduces memory costs with sparse semantic Gaussians and converts them into dense voxel occupancy through splatting. GaussianFormer-2 [ 11 ] models geometric occupancy through probabilistic superposition and semantics through a Gaussian mixture model. EmbodiedOcc++ [ 35 ] improves Gaussian representations through planar regularization and uncertainty-guided updates. RoboOcc [ 49 ] uses opacity-guided interactions and geometry-aware encoding to improve semantic and geometric prediction. Our EC-G2O operator focuses on Gaussian-to-voxel aggregation, suppressing scale inflation and excessive local evidence accumulation.
blocks.zh: 另一条工作线将高斯原始人直接聚集到voxel占用中. 高斯福尔默[14]用稀疏的语义高斯人来降低记忆成本,并通过电镀将其转化为密集的阴道占用. GaussianFormer-2[11] 模型几何占用通过概率叠加和语义通过高斯混合模型. EmbodyOcc++[35]通过平面规范化和不确定性指导更新改进了高斯代表. RoboOcc [49] 使用不透明引导的相互作用和几何感知编码来改进语义和几何预测. 我们的EC-G2O操作器专注于高斯对伏克斯的聚合,抑制规模通货膨胀和过度的本地证据积累.

blocks.en: 2.3 Open-Vocabulary Occupancy Prediction
blocks.zh: 2.3 开放词汇 使用预测

blocks.en: Language-aligned 2D [ 28 , 19 , 51 ] and 3D representations [ 26 ] support open-vocabulary scene understanding. POP-3D [ 34 ] distills 2D vision–language features into voxels for text-based 3D recognition. LangOcc [ 1 ] renders 3D language features into image space and aligns them with 2D vision–language features. These methods support open-vocabulary occupancy prediction without 3D semantic annotations.
blocks.zh: 语言对齐的2D[28,19,51]和3D的表示[26]支持开放-vobulary场景理解. POP-3D [34] 将2D视觉-语言特征蒸馏成voxels,用于基于文本的3D识别. LangOcc [1] 将3D语言特征变成图像空间,并与2D视觉–语言特征对齐. 这些方法支持没有3D语义注释的开放-vocabulary占用预测.

blocks.en: Gaussian-based methods adopt different paradigms for aggregating semantic information into voxels. LegoOcc [ 50 ] aggregates Gaussian features into voxel features before text matching, using progressive temperature decay to reduce feature blending during rendering supervision. In contrast, GaussTR [ 16 ] performs text matching on individual Gaussians and aggregates the resulting semantic scores into voxels. Feature aggregation before text matching can mix distinct semantics. Although GaussTR matches text before aggregation, each Gaussian carries a single semantic feature, and the aggregation weights are not explicitly text-conditioned. To address these limitations, our MM-QGSR represents each Gaussian with multiple semantic modes and aggregates query-specific evidence into voxels through learnable text-conditioned routing.
blocks.zh: 基于高斯的方法采用了不同的范式,将语义信息汇总到voxels中. 乐高 在文本匹配之前,高斯的特征会成为voxel的特征,利用渐进温度衰变来减少渲染过程中的特征混合. 与此相对照,高斯TR [16] 对单个高斯人进行文本匹配,并将由此产生的语义分数汇总为voxels. 在文本匹配之前的特性聚合可以混合不同的语义. 虽然高斯TR在聚合前匹配文本,但每个高斯人都带有单一的语义特征,集合权重没有明确的文本条件. 为解决这些局限性,我们的MM-QGSR代表每个高斯人,具有多种语义模式,通过可学习的文本条件路由将特定查询证据汇总成voxels.

blocks.en: Previous Poisson-based Gaussian-to-Occupancy (G2O) retains the shared α \alpha , but uses the unnormalized splatting kernel as an intensity. A single primitive cannot yield high occupancy confidence. Because a linear sum treats each overlapping primitive as an independent hit, merely duplicating a Gaussian increases occupancy just as effectively as placing it accurately. Consequently, training exploits a shortcut: compensating for inaccurate placement and weak per-primitive confidence by generating more and larger Gaussians. We propose evidence-conserving G2O (EC-G2O). Evidence is a Gaussian’s contribution to occupancy; conservation means that the integrated contribution does not grow with scale. Given the shared α \alpha , EC-G2O decouples the integrated mass from the spatial scale and attenuates the extra occupancy contributed by overlapping primitives.

blocks.en: 4.2 Main Experiment
blocks.zh: 4.2 主要实验

blocks.en: Table 1 presents the monocular occupancy prediction results on Occ-ScanNet. The closed-vocabulary methods are trained with full semantic annotations, whereas the open-vocabulary methods do not use semantic voxel labels. Under geometry-only supervision, our model achieves 63.31 IoU and 27.44 mIoU, outperforming the strongest compared baseline (59.50 / 21.05) by margins of +3.81 and +6.39, respectively. Notably, significant per-class improvements are observed: furniture rises from 5.88 to 26.92 (+21.04), ceiling from 17.81 to 35.27 (+17.46), and bed from 33.05 to 38.87 (+5.82).
blocks.zh: 表1列出Occ-ScanNet的单人占用预测结果。 闭省法则用完整的语义说明来训练,而闭省法则不使用语义性 voxel 标签. 在仅以几何为主的监督下,我们的模型实现了63.31 IoU和27.44 mIoU,分别比基准(59.50/21.05)的比差+3.81和+6.39要强。 值得注意的是,每类家具有显著改善:家具从5.88升至26.92(+21.04),上限从17.81升至35.27(+17.46),床位从33.05升至38.87(+5.82)。

blocks.en: As an extended structural surface, the substantial gain in ceiling , along with the overall IoU improvement, is primarily attributed to EC-G2O. Specifically, its mass normalization and p p -norm aggregation effectively regulate the contributions of overlapping primitives within the same voxel. Conversely, furniture and bed are discrete object categories that the compared baseline struggles to recognize. The corresponding mIoU gains are driven by the query-conditioned router, which precisely assigns language evidence to individual primitives via MM-QGSR, smooth aggregation, and subclass queries.
blocks.zh: 作为延伸的结构表面,天花板的大幅增益,加上IoU的整体改进,主要归功于EC-G2O. 具体地说,其质量正常化和p -norm聚合有效地规范了同一阴道内重叠原始人的贡献. 相反,家具和床是比较基线难以识别的离散物体类别。 相应的mIoU增益是由查询条件路由器驱动的,该路由器通过MM-QGSR,平滑聚合,以及子类查询,准确地将语言证据分配给单个原始人.

blocks.en: Remarkably, our geometric IoU of 63.31 surpasses all closed-vocabulary counterparts, including RoboOcc (56.48), demonstrating that EC-G2O achieves superior occupancy accuracy even without semantic voxel labels. For semantics, our mIoU of 27.44 outperforms closed-vocabulary models like MonoScene (24.62) and TPVFormer (24.94), though it remains slightly below ISO (28.71) and embodied-occupancy models trained with full supervision. This remaining gap reflects the inherent challenge of calibrating fine-grained categories in the absence of dense semantic annotations.
blocks.zh: 值得注意的是,我们的63.31的几何IoU超过了包括RoboOcc(56.48)在内的所有封闭式对等单位,表明EC-G2O即使没有语义性 voxel 标签也达到了较高的占用精度. 就语义而言,我们27.44的mIoU比MonoScene(24.62)和TPVFormer(24.94)等闭塞-vobulary模型要好,尽管它仍然略低于ISO(28.71)和在充分监督下接受训练的隐形使用模型。 这一尚存的差距反映了在没有密集语义说明的情况下校准细纹类的固有挑战.

blocks.en: Table 2 : Aggregation cost of EC-G2O against the Poisson baseline .
blocks.zh: 表2. EC-G2O与Poisson基线的合计成本

blocks.en: Table 2 compares the Poisson baseline with EC-G2O in terms of Gaussian-voxel pairs and overall inference latency, measured on identical hardware. This substantial reduction in evaluated pairs is inherently driven by our geometric aggregation design. By fixing the integrated mass of each primitive to α i ​ V \alpha_{i}V , mass normalization ensures that expanding the spatial scale lowers the local density peak, thereby reducing the number of Gaussians effectively contributing to any given voxel. Geometrically, the p p -norm taggregation replaces the standard weight h i h_{i} with h i p h_{i}^{p} (where p > 1 p>1 ). This exponentiation forces contributions to decay more rapidly away from the center, which mathematically tightens the effective culling radius along each semi-axis to s i ​ k / p s_{ik}/\sqrt{p} . Consequently, the total Gaussian-voxel pairs drop drastically from 3.115 × 10 6 3.115\times 10^{6} to 1.517 × 10 6 1.517\times 10^{6} ( − 51.3 % -51.3\% ), reducing the isolated aggregation time from 19.76 ms to 12.88ms ( − 34.8 % -34.8\% ). Since the full forward pass also includes the image backbone and Gaussian head, whose computational costs remain constant, the end-to-end latency achieves a more modest but meaningful reduction from 60.16 ms to 50.88 ms ( − 15.4 % -15.4\% ).
blocks.zh: 表2以相同的硬件测得的高斯-沃克塞尔对和整体推论纬度将普瓦松基线与EC-G2O进行比较. 被评价对子的这种大幅度的减少本质上是由我们的几何聚合设计驱动的. 通过将每个原始体的集成质量固定为α i V\alpha_{i} V,质量正常化可以确保空间尺度的扩大可以降低局部密度峰值,从而减少高斯人的数量,有效促进任何给定的阴道. 在几何上,p-norm标记法将标准重量h i h_{i}替换为h i p h_{i}^{p}(其中p > 1 p>1). 这种振荡力促使中心更迅速地衰变,数学上将每个半轴上的有效振荡半径收紧到s i k / p s_{ik}/\sqrt{p}. 因此,高斯琴-伏克斯琴的对数从3.115×10 6 3.115\times 10^{6}急剧下降到1.517×10 6 1.517\times 10^{6}(−51.3%-51.3\%),将孤立的集合时间从19.76毫秒减少到12.88毫秒(−34.8%-34.8\% ) 。 由于完整的前进通道还包括图像主干线和高斯琴头,其计算成本保持不变,端到端的纬度从60.16毫秒下降到50.88毫秒(−15.4%-15.4\% ) 。

blocks.en: 4.3 Ablation Study
blocks.zh: 4.3 发育研究

blocks.en: To validate the contribution of each proposed module, we conduct a cumulative ablation study. Starting from the Poisson baseline, components are progressively incorporated, with the resulting performance detailed in Table 3 .
blocks.zh: 为了证实每个拟议单元的贡献,我们进行了累积的消化研究。 从Poisson基线开始,组成部分逐步纳入,由此产生的性能详见表3。

blocks.en: Introducing mass normalization improves mIoU to 22.82 and IoU to 61.46, indicating that balancing primitive contributions inherently aids semantic recognition. Replacing the standard sum with p p -norm aggregation drives a substantial geometric leap, pushing IoU to 63.31 (+3.81 over the baseline). However, this modification causes a slight mIoU dip (from 22.82 to 22.64). This trade-off occurs because while p p -norm aggregation effectively suppresses dominant Gaussians to refine structural boundaries (boosting IoU), it simultaneously attenuates the concentrated feature responses required for distinguishing fine-grained semantics.
blocks.zh: 采用大众正常化法将mIoU提升至22.82,IoU提升至61.46,表明平衡原始贡献本质上有助于语义识别. 用p -norm 聚合取代标准总和驱动了一个重大的几何跳跃,将IoU推向63.31(比基线高+3.81). 然而,这一修改导致mIoU的微调(从22.82到22.64). 这种权衡之所以发生,是因为虽然p -norm聚合有效地压制了占支配地位的高斯人来细化结构界限(促进IoU),但它同时减弱了区分细纹语义所需的集中特征反应.

blocks.en: The subsequent three modules, namely MM-QGSR, smooth aggregation, and fine-grained subclass queries, are designed explicitly to recover and enhance semantic fidelity. Upon introducing MM-QGSR, mIoU climbs steadily from 22.64 to 23.79, further improves to 24.73 with smooth aggregation, and ultimately surges to 27.44 with fine-grained subclass queries. This final step delivers the most significant semantic boost (+2.71 over smooth aggregation and +6.39 over the baseline), proving its critical role in resolving broad categories. The configuration in the final row corresponds exactly to the full model evaluated in Table 1 .
blocks.zh: 随后的三个模块,即MM-QGSR、光滑聚合和精细的子类查询,明确是为了恢复和加强语义忠诚。 在引入MM-QGSR后,mIoU从22.64稳步攀升到23.79,随着平稳聚合而进一步提升到24.73,最终通过精细分级查询而猛增到27.44. 这一最后步骤提供了最显著的语义助推(比平稳汇总加2.71,比基线加6.39),证明了其在解决大类问题方面的关键作用。 最后一行的配置与表1评价的完整模型完全一致。

Furthermore, our model predicts television instances more completely and assigns their semantic labels with higher accuracy.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
This paper presents GCSR-OCC, a novel framework that advances monocular 3D occupancy prediction via geometric calibration and semantic routing. Geometrically, our evidence-conserving Gaussian-to-occupancy (EC-G2O) operator effectively suppresses scale inflation and attenuates excessive local evidence accumulation. Semantically, the proposed multimodal query-conditioned Gaussian semantic routing (MM-QGSR) mitigates feature mixing both across and within individual primitives. These designs are further complemented by fine-grained subclass queries and smooth aggregation to enhance open-vocabulary recognition.
Geometry is trained with binary occupancy supervision, and the semantic router is distilled from a frozen 2D teacher. Trained solely without dense 3D semantic annotations, GCSR-OCC achieves a geometric IoU of 63.31% and an open-vocabulary mIoU of 27.44% on Occ-ScanNet. Moreover, by substantially reducing Gaussian-voxel pairs during splatting, our method simultaneously decreases aggregation latency, demonstrating that rigorous geometric design can unify prediction accuracy with computational efficiency. Future work will explore generative models for completing the geometry and semantics of occluded regions from a single RGB image.
blocks.zh:
本文介绍了GCSR-OCC,这是一种通过几何校准和语义路由推进单光谱立体占用预测的新框架. 从几何角度来说,我们的证据保护高斯人对使用(EC-G2O)操作者有效地抑制了规模通货膨胀,缓解了当地过度的证据积累。 从语义上讲,拟议的多式联运查询条件高斯语语义路由(MM-QGSR)减轻了个人原始人之间和内部的特征混合. 这些设计还进一步辅以精细的子类查询和平滑的聚合,以增强开放式的vobulary识别.
几何学通过二进制占用监督进行训练,语义路由器由冷冻的2D教师蒸馏而成. GCSR-OCC完全没有密集的三维语义说明,在Occ-ScanNet上实现了63.31%的几何IoU和27.44%的开放的mIoU。 此外,通过在镀层过程中大量减少高斯-伏牛座的对数,我们的方法同时降低了聚合的延迟度,表明严格的几何设计可以将预测精度与计算效率统一起来. 未来的工作将探索从单一的RGB图像中完成寡斑区域的几何学和语义学的基因模型.
